start.title: Welcome
start.lead: Tabrion Studio is a local developer tool for SQLite and PostgreSQL databases. It runs on this computer only and is read-only by default.
start.projectsBody: Studio works with the connection profiles of the project folder you started tabrion-studio in, and with your own profiles. It only reads: nothing here changes a database.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.lead: Checks a connection's database against tabrion's rules and Studio's own: roles, timeouts, TLS, foreign keys and file permissions. The diagnosis only reads. It starts only when you run it, since SQLite's integrity check can take a while.
diagnostics.runningNote: The diagnosis is running. It stops at the connection's time limit, or when you cancel it.
diagnostics.cancelFailed: Studio could not cancel the diagnosis. It stops at the connection's time limit; you can try to cancel it again.
diagnostics.noProfiles: There are no connection profiles yet. Add one under Connections.

result.none: No findings: the checks found nothing to report.
result.incomplete: Not every check ran (STU-DX-008), so this result is incomplete. Run the diagnosis again.
result.serverText: Details and remedies are the checks' own English text.

download.note: The report runs the diagnosis again on the shown connection. It leaves out passwords, hosts, ports, user and database names, file paths and values.
download.making: Making the report. Studio runs the diagnosis again for it…
download.cancelNotTaken: The report was dropped and nothing was saved, but Studio could not stop its diagnosis on the server. It ends at the connection's time limit.

backup.title: Backups
backup.lead: Hints about backups. They are not findings, so the summary above does not count them.
backup.none: No backup hints: Studio found nothing to point out about backups.
backup.unchecked: Backups were not checked in this run, so this says nothing about them. Run the diagnosis again.
backup.invalid: The backup hints in the answer could not be read, so none are shown.
backup.more_one: And {{count}} more backup hint, not shown.
backup.more_other: And {{count}} more backup hints, not shown.

trustCode.title: Run the project's migration code?
trustCode.body: To read the revisions, Studio imports the project's Alembic files, which runs their code on this computer, in a separate process that stops after 30 seconds. The code runs as you, as with alembic heads: it gets the open connection's address and password, so it can change the database, and it can read your files and Studio's settings. Trust it only if you would run it yourself. Studio asks again when alembic.ini or a revision file changes; the project modules that revision files import are trusted with them but not checked for changes.
trustCode.stale: The files changed after they were shown. This is the new list: review it again before you trust it.
